changelog:
Add optional per-user execution profiles for GPU acceleration, FFmpeg flags, stall timeout, and network retries with global inheritance
Capture the effective execution policy at playback startup for consistent session behavior
Report active execution diagnostics without exposing raw FFmpeg flags or credentials
Add regression coverage for execution resolution, validation, persistence, startup wiring, status/API behavior, and the configuration page
See CHANGELOG.md for the complete release history
description: Synchronize Philips Hue lights with your media playback in real-time.
name: Philips Hue Sync
overview: Adds support for real-time lighting synchronization with Philips Hue Entertainment Areas using the streaming DTLS API. Features cinema mode, scene restoration, per-user bridge mappings, playback performance, color scene, execution, and restoration profiles, advanced color processing, and auto-reconnection.
